Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the neuropeptide S receptor (CHEMBL5162) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5162 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID.
